name: Marinport: Stream Town
source:
You play as a moon jelly girl trying to make it as an indie idol.

You’re drowning in debt, your shady night job isn’t paying all the bills, and your dream of becoming an idol feels further away than ever. But hope’s not lost, there’s a massive music competition with a life-changing cash prize and a shot at instant fame.

[Edited from [url=https://3005jin.itch.io/stream-town]itch.io[/url]]
